messages.subject: First Davis - R Users' Group (D-RUG) meeting of the quarter this Thursday, April 6th
messages.subject_clean: First Davis - R Users' Group (D-RUG) meeting of the quarter this Thursday, April 6th
messages.body_plain:
Hi all,

D-RUG will take place on Thursdays this quarter from 12 - 2 pm. We will have both in-person (360 Shields Library) and zoom <https://ucdavis.zoom.us/j/92807937862> options to delve into all your R questions!

The first part of our meeting this week will be discussing the schedule for the quarter, followed by open work time.

Hope to see you there!
Your D-RUG Coo[R]dinators

________________________________________________________________
Please remember to post your questions to our Discourse <https://d-rug.discourse.group/> site in advance of attending D-RUG virtually. This helps us do a better job of answering your questions, and also keep a log of the types of questions we see frequently.

For those not familiar with D-RUG, the R Users' Group is a weekly working group to get some help with R-specific coding problems. The coordinators are various and sundry coding connoisseurs, ranging from UCD data scientists to grad students on campus. We meet for 2 hours in an open-forum format, so you can treat D-RUG as a communal, co-working environment: come hang out and chat, work on your own, seek help, make friends. Or, a little bit of everything! Check out our website <https://d-rug.github.io/> for more information.

Hope to see you there!
Your D-RUG Coo[R]dinators

Mini-workshop schedule:
April 20: Mapping big data in R with geoarrow and geoparquet
April 27: R coding style, and the lintr and styler packages
May 4: Function writing
May 11: Iterations (for loops, map, apply functions)
May 18: Build a website with Rmarkdown and Github pages
May 25: R in the browser (WebR package)
June 1: Spatial data in R
June 8: Converting text into data with regular expressions

messages.subject: Fwd: [datascience-announce] [TRAINING] Register now for Data Visualization Workshops @ DataLab
messages.subject_clean: [datascience-announce] [TRAINING] Register now for Data Visualization Workshops @ DataLab
messages.body_plain:
Lot's of visualization workshops are coming up -- check them out!

---------- Forwarded message ---------
From: Pamela L Reynolds <plrey...@ucdavis.edu>
Date: Wed, Apr 19, 2023 at 9:54 AM
Subject: [datascience-announce] [TRAINING] Register now for Data Visualization Workshops @ DataLab
To: datascience-announce Sympa List <datascienc...@ucdavis.edu>

There’s still space to register for the upcoming data visualization workshops at UC Davis DataLab <https://datalab.ucdavis.edu/>! See links below and attached Spring 2023 flyer.

Upcoming DataLab Trainings & Events
April 20, 10am-12pm - Principles of Data Visualization <https://datalab.ucdavis.edu/eventscalendar/principles-of-data-visualization-from-perception-to-statistical-graphics/>
May 2, 2-4pm - Building Web Maps with Leaflet (with #maptimeDavis) <https://datalab.ucdavis.edu/eventscalendar/building-web-maps-with-leaflet-maptimedavis-2/>
May 4, 10am-12pm - Intermediate Python: Next-Level Data Visualization <https://datalab.ucdavis.edu/eventscalendar/intermediate-python-next-level-data-visualization-2/>
May 11, 10am-12pm - Intermediate R: Next-Level Data Visualization <https://datalab.ucdavis.edu/eventscalendar/intermediate-r-next-level-data-visualization/>
May 16, 2-4pm - Introduction to GIS with QGIS (with #maptimeDavis) <https://datalab.ucdavis.edu/eventscalendar/introduction-to-gis-with-qgis-maptimedavis-2/>
May 18, 10am-12pm - Network Visualization <https://datalab.ucdavis.edu/eventscalendar/network-visualization/>
May 25, 10am-12pm - Technologies for Interactive and Dynamic Data Visualization <https://datalab.ucdavis.edu/eventscalendar/technologies-for-interactive-and-dynamic-data-visualization/>
June 1, 10am-12pm - Visualizing Your Research Data with Virtual Reality <https://datalab.ucdavis.edu/eventscalendar/visualizing-your-research-data-with-virtual-reality/>

See our event calendar  <https://datalab.ucdavis.edu/workshops/>for additional workshops, user group meetups, and past event recordings.

--

Pamela L. Reynolds, PhD

Associate Director

DataLab: Data Science and Informatics

University of California, Davis

plrey...@ucdavis.edu
https://datalab.ucdavis.edu

The UC Davis DataLab <https://datalab.ucdavis.edu/> seeks to promote academic and research excellence through quality programs, engaged researchers, and an innovative research and learning environment and to meet growing industry and academic need for graduates with data science skills. To that end, the DataLab complements existing and developing educational programs to facilitate research in data science and provide a niche for students, faculty, and professional researchers seeking to move beyond their individual programs and explore new opportunities. To sign up for our data science listserv “datascience-announce” or to manage your subscription, see instructions here <https://datalab.ucdavis.edu/mailing-list/>. We can be reached at https://datalab.ucdavis.edu and dat...@ucdavis.edu.

--
Liza Wood (she/her)
PhD Candidate | Graduate Group in Ecology
Center for Environmental Policy and Behavior
University of California, Davis
https://liza-wood.github.io/
